Title: FBI Special Affairs Division and the Imbued

Messages.Author: wastaz
Messages.Body:
> FBI Special Affairs Division
> Government.
> When an ally is burned in combat with an acting vampire, put a counter on this card, and that acting vampire takes 2 unpreventable damage (after combat ends). Burn this card when it has 4 counters.
>
Seeing that Imbued counts as allies, I guess that this card would work for those as well. However, Imbued doesn't really "burn" in combat that often as they become incapacitated instead. Is there actually any way that an Imbued could trigger the FBI?

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: There are a couple of Strike: burn ally. Those will burn an Imbued too, but they rarely see play.

> Pendargon wrote:

Nope. It only triggers when there's an acting vampire.
You can play Fast Reaction with Alia, let her burn, and it would still trigger the FBI.
